lines: The Zombies that broke into the private room collapsed one after another to Akitsu's sword handling.
(Seeing it from up close, her skill with a sword is amazing. It's almost beautiful.)
But the sound of battle seemed to be drawing in even more Zombies.
You're really persistent, aren't you?! I'm starting to get tired!
I guess you don't have time to think about it. Captain, will you accept my request? You finished taking the vaccine, I imagine.
I threw away the empty ampoule, shared a glance with Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and nodded.
Capturing Gaiza was the most important mission for the Independent Commando Unit. This was Gaiza in possession of a dangerous bioweapon and trying to establish his power in the underworld.
No need to even ask. We're definitely going to stop him.
ーBut before that, there's just one thing I want to confirm.
Why are you asking us to do this? If you're with the UFS, shouldn't it be faster to mobilize your own people?
I can't. Not at the moment.
How do you suppose Gaiza knew about the UFS's top secret CD Virus?
In other words, there was a mole within the UFS.
That meant there was a high probability that someone in the UFS was selling information to Nomad.
So you want to utilize us and deal with this in secret.
That's right♪ And one more thing.
You know by now that the UFS is divided into several organizations and that they aren't a monolith.
And I'm sure that other UFS organizations are already chasing after the stolen virus by now...
I want you to go and retrieve the goods before anyone else does.
I'm fine with stealing the virus, but what guarantee is there that it won't be used for evil once I hand it over to you?
There is none. You'll just have to trust me.
Our goal is to destroy or seal any technology from the Devildom. We will show no mercy to anyone standing in our way.
Even if it's another UFS organization?
...Alright, I'll believe you. It seems best to hand over the virus to you.
Such a dangerous virus must be reclaimed and eradicated from this world as soon as possible.
It was a larger purpose that went beyond personal interests and bargaining.
Hehe♪ What a lovely answer, Captain.
The masked lady smiled pleasantly and called out to Akitsu, who was holding the Zombies in check at the entrance of the private room.
Akitsu!! Lead them to where the virus is.
Oh? You finally finished talking, huh!
Akitsu instantly retreated to the window and drove the swords on her back into the expensive-looking glass.
Alright. Hebiko! Shikanosuke! Time to scram!! We'll escape to the rear through the window!!
Leave the Zombies to me, now go!
The Masked Madam smiled graciously and turned toward the Zombies that came rushing in, preparing herself for battle.
(She'll take care of those Zombies single handedly? ーDon't you die like this, masked lady!)
What are you doing!? Hurry up!
I jumped through the glass window that Akitsu had smashed and escaped to the back street.
